facts.fact: ITWeb reports the Protection of Personal Information Act came into force on 1 July 2021 after a year-long grace period.
ITWeb reports the Information Regulator, headed by Pansy Tlakula, was set up in December 2016 and enforces POPIA.
ITWeb reports the Information Regulator has issued enforcement notices under POPIA, with First National Bank and a TVET college among the most recent found in breach.
